finding.description: Retirez les commentaires sensibles du HTML livré en production.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: sensitive-html-comments (Retirez les commentaires sensibles du HTML livré en production. Evidence: Des commentaires HTML publics contiennent des indices sensibles (notes internes, identifiants, chemins).). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Fix: remove sensitive HTML comments from production HTML. Review delivered pages and strip internal notes, identifiers, paths and debugging info, because comments and metadata in HTML might reveal internal information that should not be available to attackers. Check source for <!-- comments containing SQL code, usernames/passwords, internal IPs or debugging information.
